what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Colombia, counted by IDMC and UNHCR side by side.
At the end of 2025, IDMC estimated 7210702 people living in internal displacement because of conflict and violence, and UNHCR counted 7157716.
Refugees from Colombia live mainly in Ecuador and Venezuela.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Colombia in every year from 2003 to 2025, with the ELN, FARC, FARC-EMC and FARC - Segunda Marquetalia among the government's opponents.
UCDP records the conflict at war level from 2003 to 2005.
Floods, storms, droughts, earthquakes, erosion, mass movements and wildfires are the disasters recorded for Colombia in IDMC's data.

when.text: IDMC's figure rose from 4915579 in 2009 to a peak of 7264767 in 2024.
New displacements from conflict were highest in 2025 in IDMC's records.

how.text: In 2025 IDMC counts 52986 more internally displaced people than UNHCR; the figures are never added together.
IDMC's figure is a year-end total of everyone still displaced, so it includes people displaced in earlier years.
